title: 資料來源頁顯示休市／交易日語意一致的新鮮度說明，並清除內部 nan 字串預設值

acceptance_1_session_aware_freshness_and.behavior: Formats both age_seconds and sla_seconds in human-readable units (seconds, minutes, or hours such as '2m old of 24h SLA' instead of raw '86400s SLA'). When freshness / freshness_status is 'fresh' or 'empty_fresh' while wall-clock age exceeds nominal SLA due to market session/holiday calendar semantics (or an explicit session/holiday freshness reason), renders session-aware freshness explanation ('<age> wall-clock age · session-fresh across non-trading session/holiday (<sla> trading-day SLA)') and matching top-level readiness explanation instead of contradicting the fresh badge. Genuinely stale sources (>SLA with freshness='stale') render '<age> old of <sla> SLA (exceeded)' without claiming session-fresh carry.

acceptance_2_nan_fallback_removal_in_per.behavior: Removed all literal 'nan' fallback strings from connectorHealthSources and normalizeSource. Missing, null, empty, or nan-like strings map to null in normalizeDataSourceString (or 'unavailable' placeholder for required ManagementDataSource identity/status fields and undefined for optional fields), and missing/NaN numeric counts map to null in normalizeDataSourceNumber so 'nan' never leaks into rendered cells, badges, or labels.

results.DataSourcesPage.test.tsx: 5 passed (within-SLA human-readable 2m old of 24h SLA, session-fresh >24h market source on non-trading day/holiday, genuinely stale >24h source, helper unit tests for formatDuration/formatAgeVsSla/ageLabel/readinessExplanation with freshness_status and freshness_reason, and unavailable projection error handling)
results.personaFleetDataSources.test.ts: 4 passed (normalizeDataSourceString and normalizeDataSourceNumber null mapping, normalizeSource unavailable placeholder mapping, connector_health/dataSources/providerStatuses/live_source_connector_ids/providerStatusCounts/providerCount nan-free normalization, and snake_case data_source_summary handling)

runtime_budget.notes: Pure frontend presentation and data normalization logic; adds 0 recurring jobs, 0 emitters, and 0 persistent writers.

residual_findings.description: Out of scope for this task's artifact list: V2 DataSourceInstancesTable column 4 ('Observed Health / Freshness') renders 'Age: <formatAgeSeconds>' from dto.observed.freshness.age_seconds without market-session carry wording when a V2 instance row has health_state='healthy' across a weekend or holiday.
